verdict.rationale: Founders Workbench is a free public resource with Form, Finance, Operate, Hire, Partner and Protect build guides. It includes a plain-language formation guide on corporations versus LLCs and a financing explainer on SAFEs, plus dilution and liquidation calculators. Equity is covered only through a calculator tool rather than a written explainer, no FAQs are shown, and the evidence never explicitly ties foundersworkbench.com to Goodwin's own pages. missing for 10: a plain-language equity explainer or guide (not just a calculator), evidence of FAQs, explicit confirmation that Founders Workbench is Goodwin-owned, independent corroboration of the knowledge base's depth.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: Founders Workbench is a resource to help ease the process by providing you with free information and tools
Corporations and Limited Liability Companies (LLCs) are the preferred entities for start-ups because of the limited liability protection they afford owners.

The Safe will convert into equity at the time of an equity financing, usually at a discounted rate and/or subject to some maximum value. Unlike a convertible note, the Safe does not accrue interest or have a maturity date.
The Capital Calculator enables you to compare the amount of dilution that would be experienced by common shareholders from the issuance of preferred stock under different financing terms.
